title: fix(service-analytics)!: query_dataset refuses measures and dimensions the dataset does not declare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_

Fixes #33745

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — query_dataset stops accepting measures and dimensions the dataset does not declare; one CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review owed before the queue
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no raw field or ad-hoc `count` through `query_dataset`; the MCP-served skill text (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`) already says `selection` takes members "by the names `list_datasets` gives", which is what is now enforced.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：AI 的数据集查询工具 `query_dataset` 现在只接受数据集里声明过的指标和维度；传入原始字段（如 `amount`）、临时的 `count` 或未声明的维度时，直接返回 400 `INVALID_FIELD`，并列出该用户可用的指标与维度。
- **为什么改**：之前这类请求会被分析服务临时拼出一个聚合并照常返回，答案的「来源」却把它标成数据集的正式指标（「来源：指标 amount · 数据集 …」），把非指标口径冒充成治理指标；ADR-0149 规定数据集是唯一的声明定义。
- **风险与回滚**：对 AI/MCP 调用方是收紧（BREAKING）：以前能答的未声明成员现在被拒，模型需改选声明成员或退回对象查询（非指标口径）。REST 数据集接口、仪表盘、报表不走此工具，不受影响。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` 的 `assertDeclaredMembers`（判定与报错文案，只列本用户可见成员）；同文件 `queryDataset` 中调用它的位置（在数据集解析之后、任何读取之前）；测试 `src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts` 新增的 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`，预期 43 个用例全部通过，其中「refuses a member the dataset does not declare」一组 11 个。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（落地前欠一次 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 契约复审记录）。

## What changes

- `createDatasetTools` (`@objectstack/service-analytics`, the one executor behind the product AI's chat tool and the MCP `query_dataset` on both bridges) judges the selection against the dataset it resolved, after the dataset resolves and before anything is read. A name in `selection.measures`, `selection.dimensions` or a `selection.timeDimensions` entry's `dimension` that is not one of the dataset's own `measures[].name` / `dimensions[].name` is refused `400 INVALID_FIELD` with `member`, `param` and `cube` (the dataset name), through `invalidMemberError`, the envelope the service's member-level refusals already answer. No new error code.
- The message names the measures and dimensions this caller may use (the catalogue admission `list_datasets` lists from), never a withheld member or one over an `internal` field, and points at the D3 fallback (object query tools, 非指标口径).
- Judged against every declared member, so a declared member the caller may not read still reaches the service's own field gate (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`), unchanged. A missing or hidden dataset is still `404 NOT_FOUND` first. `totals.groupings` and `order` keys are already judged downstream against the selected members.
- `query_dataset`'s tool description now states the rule.
- Changeset `.changeset/33745-query-dataset-declared-members.md`: patch (`Metadata-protocol: none`), BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Tests

- New top-level `describe('query_dataset refuses a member the dataset does not declare')` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/__tests__/dataset-tools.test.ts`: a raw field as a measure, the ad-hoc `count`, a suffix spelling `amount_sum`, a dataset-qualified `pipeline.revenue`, an undeclared measure beside a declared one, a raw field as a dimension and as a time dimension — each `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 with `member` / `param` / `cube`, on both faces (`queryDataset` and `execute`), the service never called, no read. Plus: the message names only caller-usable members; a missing or hidden dataset stays `NOT_FOUND`; two CONTROLs (every declared measure, a derived one included, and dimensions are served; a declared time dimension reaches the service).
- Red first on the `origin/main` executor: 7 failed / 35 passed (before the qualified-spelling case was added).
- Ablation 1 (the call to `assertDeclaredMembers` removed, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 -> 0): 8 failed / 35 passed; restored, blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (the caller-visible filter on the named members widened to every declared member): 1 failed (`expected ... not to contain 'margin_total'`); restored the same way.

## Acceptance notes

- Hypothesis readings: H1 held (on `origin/main` the executor served `measures: ['amount']`, `['count']`, `dimensions: ['amount']`, `pipeline.revenue` and `pipeline.stage`, each with provenance citing the raw name as a member). H2: the MCP tool (HTTP and stdio bridges, `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) and the chat registry face share this executor, so one refusal covers them; the REST door `POST /analytics/dataset/query` does NOT go through it (it calls `AnalyticsService.queryDataset` directly) and is not changed: it serves dashboards, reports and ad-hoc selections, and the card's ruling names the tool's executor. H3: a dataset declares no implicit `count`; `count` is minted by the service's `inferMeasure`, so it is refused here. H4: `INVALID_FIELD` / 400 (ADR-0149 D2 lists it among the codes the tool may answer; the tool invents no code).
- A `dataset.member` qualified spelling of a DECLARED member is refused too: it is not a name `list_datasets` lists, and its provenance used to cite the raw spelling with no label. Called out in case a consumer relies on it.
- The REST door's closed-member question and the ADR-0149 D2 line are on #34005 (maintainer decision).

## Dogfood battery (head `3f717733a13e3d0b4cbd952afa4148c5b35b196c`)

- Local run: NOT MEASURED (the shared verify lock was held by long sibling suites; five attempts ended queue-timeout 99).
- The battery of record is the merge group's required `Dogfood Regression Gate`, accepted as such by the seat (15:54Z condition, reading accepted 15:57Z). Its selector runs the full dogfood suite for this diff: in `ci.yml` the job's `if:` needs `filter.outputs.core != 'false'`, and the `filter` job forces `core` to `'true'` on `merge_group`; `OS_SEED_ONLY` is `queue-verdict.outputs.covered == 'true'`, and `queue-verdict` runs on `push` only, so on `merge_group` all three shards run `turbo run test --filter=@objectstack/dogfood` in full. `@objectstack/dogfood` depends on `@objectstack/service-analytics`, so its test hash moves with this diff (no cache hit).
